All other terms and conditions of the MOU remain in full force and effect.
funding_source: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant
headline: Adds $1,079 for Bay Area Community Resources' school-day support at Prescott Elementary, raising total to $111,361
summary: This amendment to a 2020-21 memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources adds $1,079.00, raising the cap from $110,282.00 to $111,361.00. The extra money increases staff time to support teachers during class, help students with academics in groups and one on one, and lead daily physical activities over Zoom. The term is August 1, 2020 to July 31, 2021.
source_issue: The title names Brookfield Elementary School, but the action text names Prescott Elementary School.
